Outer space is obviously unimaginably vast and wondrous, and it contains a multitude of fascinating astronomical objects and phenomena at a variety of scales. So which one's your favorite, and why? Here's a list of them if you need some ideas.
What's your favorite astronomical object or phenomenon, and why?

The hexagon on top of Saturn, by a long way.

Edit: Why? because for the spooky among us, Saturn is the sixth planet, it has a hexagon on top, and its name has 6 letters. Cue the Twilight Zone theme...

its name has 6 letters

That's a really weak association though. The Roman god's name was originally pronounced Saturnius. That could have been anglicized in several ways, so the fact that it ended up as six letters doesn't mean anything. In Spanish, it's Saturno.

If you want to be creeped out by Saturn, check out Francisco Goya's painting, Saturn Devouring His Son

Another cool story about Saturn is why A.C. Clarke choose it as the location of the Monolith for the book, 2001 A Space Odyssey. It wasn't because the rings are pretty. According to another book (The Lost Worlds of 2001), at the time, in the 1960s, scientists thought that the rings could not possibly last longer than a few million years. That meant that it was incredibly unlikely that we'd be around to witness them, suggesting they were created as a sign, for us. It's sort of like how Tycho crater on the moon looks like an "x marks the spot" sort of thing.

Next, A.C.Clarke asked a bunch of astronomers if there were any objects in the solar system that had even a remote chance of being artificial, not natural. At the top of everyone's list was Saturn's moon Iapetus. They knew back in the '60s that exactly 1/2 of the moon was very dark, and the other half was very bright. But nobody could think of an explanation for why it should be like that.

There are a subsection of emails we can validate through DKIM that can be presumed to be unaltered. There is plenty of damning stuff in those emails, so that's no small thing.

But at the end of the day we have been told that Clinton's email server was hacked. The current story as I understand it is that there was malware loaded on the email server:

https://archive.is/7DeYj

If this is true, then it is not unreasonable to assert that someone sophisticated enough to both target that server specifically, and obtain the information therein could also obtain the DKIM private key from that same server.
